It also must hold up against weather, chemicals, UV exposure, and demanding service conditions. Common uses include aircraft exterior surfaces, where it is ideal for fixed-wing aircraft and helicopters that require a tough, glossy finish on the outer surfaces, such as fuselage sections, fairings, access panels, and other exposed components.
